basedOn: Standard physiology: tissue-specific cellular uptake of absorbed monomers and their oxidation / storage / structural use. A thin teaching stage, not a personal metabolic readout.
sources: NIDDK - Your Digestive System & How It Works: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/digestive-system-how-it-works
Hall & Hall, Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. - Unit XII, Gastrointestinal Physiology
Boron & Boulpaep, Medical Physiology, 3rd ed. - The Gastrointestinal System

uptake.label: Cellular uptake
uptake.detail: Monomers already past the villi and liver enter cells via tissue-specific transporters. Thin teaching stage - not a personal metabolic lab.

oxidizeOrStore.label: Oxidize / store / build
oxidizeOrStore.detail: Fuel to mitochondria (ATP), storage (glycogen/lipid), or structural use (amino acids). Framing only - no fabricated efficiency percentages.

handoff.label: Cellular use closed
handoff.detail: Cellular use is off-lumen and sits on the absorbed-nutrient lane. The unabsorbed-residue lane branched off earlier at the ileum (jejunum stage) and never passes through the systemic/cell compartment; it is picked up next as stage.colon only because the process lists stages in narrative order.
